audit.name: Primary bedroom
audit.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. King bed with a low headboard on the west wall, centred between the two west windows (W15 and W14, both kept, with the same two-sash unit), with a nightstand under each; the rear sliding door W01 opens to the garden. Open to the vestibule at the south-east corner (D10, 4′7″ wide, no door).

audit.name: Bedroom 2
audit.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Entered from the hall through the hinged door D12 (2′8″) in its south wall, as on the architect's sheet; the reach-in closet M15 opens off the same wall behind two sliding panels (D13). The rear window W02 runs from a 2′0″ sill to the ceiling.

audit.name: Primary bathroom
audit.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Laid out as on the architect's sheet: a 5′0″ × 3′0″ curbless shower in the north-west corner under the skylight W20, the toilet in the south-west corner, a 6′6″ double vanity along the south wall, the door D08 at the east end of the north wall and the window W13 on the west wall, its mullion on the shower's glass line. Walls: natural stacked stone on the vanity wall (south); every other wall plain white from the floor to the ceiling above a white tile base; matte white tile in the shower; white ceiling.

audit.name: Shared bathroom
audit.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. Entered from the hall through the hinged door D07 (2′4″) in its north wall.

audit.name: Walk-in closet
audit.note: Clear interior size; excludes walls. An enclosed room off the primary suite's vestibule, behind the sliding pocket door D18 (2′6″ × 6′8″) in its east wall. Hanging rods and shelves on the north, west and south walls, with a drawer and shelf tower on the west wall; no window; flush ceiling light.

audit.name: Bedroom 4
